# Verified Bases — full agent brief

Verified Bases is an archived storefront experiment for inspectable software starting points. It preserves the catalogue, verification method, proposed pricing tiers, and fulfilment design without claiming an active store.

## Index

# Verified Bases

Paid checkout, provisioning, fulfilment, and marketplace submissions are not live. The archive did not prove buyer demand or support economics.
